notablePrerequisites:
Prophetic Ravings attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
At least one card in hand.
description:
Tap Famished Paladin to discard a card and draw a card.
When you draw a card, Shabraz will trigger, gaining you 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Gaining the life untaps Famished Paladin.
Repeat.
